description_en: Modifies the ECS security group bound to an ApsaraDB for MongoDB instance
description_zh: 更改MongoDB实例已绑定的ECS安全组
kebab_example: aliyun dds modify-security-group-configuration --db-instance-id dds-bpxxxxxxxx --security-group-id sg-bpxxxxxxxx --region cn-hangzhou
name: ModifySecurityGroupConfiguration

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the ECS security group.

You can bind up to 10 ECS security groups to an ApsaraDB for MongoDB instance.

You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/25556.html operation of ECS to query the security groups in the specified region
parameters.help_zh:
ECS安全组ID。

1个实例最多可以绑定10个ECS安全组。
您可以通过调用ECS的https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/25556.html接口查询目标地域的安全组ID
parameters.name: security_group_id
